changes_vs_current: Sources grew from 3 to 7 averaged people sources (added YouGov Ratings Q3 2026 with full API rows, French's/OnePoll 2021, Coventry Direct 2025 and 2020 Google Trends state studies, Datassential 2014). Method order was Turkey, Grilled Cheese, Tuna, Chicken, Pulled Pork, Cheesesteak, PB&J, Ham, Roast Beef, BLT, Cuban, Lobster Roll, Po' Boy, Club, Meatball... Moves: Grilled Cheese kept #1 over Turkey (gut check; #1 in YouGov 2019, Talker 2024, YouGov Ratings 2026 and Tillamook 2025; Turkey's 0.4 lead came only from the partial Datassential list). Tuna 7->3 and Pulled Pork 8->5 (YouGov Ratings 2026, state search data, French's has BBQ pulled pork #2). Philly Cheesesteak 13->6 (YouGov Ratings 2026 #2 sandwich at 74%, French's #1, state search wins) - note said underrated, confirmed. Chicken 3->4, PB&J 6->7, Ham 5->8, Roast Beef 4->9. BLT stays in top 10 (9->10, YouGov 2019 tied #5, Datassential top 10). Club 10->11 (gut-check move up from method #14; YouGov 2019 68%, no source puts it lower). Italian Sub 16->12 (gut-check move up from method #33; French's/OnePoll #3, no source puts it lower). Cuban 17->13, Lobster Roll 22->14, Po' Boy 21->15 (now backed by 3 sources each: YouGov 2019/YouGov Ratings plus both state search studies). Meatball Sub 11->16 (YouGov 2019 #13 of 17 and Talker last of 8 put it lower). Reuben 14->17 (gut-check move up from method #22; YouGov 2019 #14 at 48% puts it lower than the gut, French's #4). Banh Mi 18 stays (2020 state search, TasteAtlas tie-break). Pastrami on Rye 19->23 (Coventry 4 states). New: Bacon Sandwich 19 (YouGov 2019 67%), Bacon Egg and Cheese 20, Bologna 21, Fluffernutter 22 (2020 state search), Brisket Sandwich 24 (Coventry 2 states). Dropped for lack of any data: Egg Salad (only YouGov 2019 58%, averaged below the tail), French Dip (only YouGov 2019 46%), Chicken Parm, Muffuletta, Gyro (no source). Patty Melt excluded as hamburger-type; Sloppy Joe (YouGov Ratings 66%) averaged just outside 24. Aliases 'tuna', 'philly', 'ham and cheese', 'bacon lettuce tomato', 'po boy', 'pulled pork sandwich', 'bbq sandwich' added.
confidence: medium. Top 10 each have 2-5 people sources and the top 3 are steady across polls. Tuna's #3 and Cuban/Lobster Roll/Po' Boy at 13-15 are pushed up by state-by-state search studies that reward regional favorites. Ranks 17-24 mostly rest on one source each (a 2020 Google Trends state map) and a near-tie at the bottom, so Sloppy Joe, Egg Salad and French Dip could fairly swap in. No national US search-volume or delivery-app sandwich ranking could be read (Google Trends returned 429; Grubhub/DoorDash/Uber Eats reports name no sandwich lists).
